name: Data.heightLe_volume_rows
summary: Complete y to a basis by good parts of crude rows; one_determinant with the index matrices of y, extended by the scalar of the crude rows, bounds the height of the volume ratios.

steps.claim: From I: weights e with ∑_{l∈U} e(l) ≤ δ (he) and the index matrices (I). From `Data.crude_rows`: a nowhere-zero γ (twists → ℂˣ) costing 2m·m squares (hγ), such that the forms on Y₀ are spanned by the crude forms ψ: (γ(ϑ)/γ(1))·ι_ϑ(ψ) ι-integral above every l prime to the level of ϑ, and every conjugate of every value of ι_1(ψ) of squared norm ≤ exp(x₁_D²·b_D²) (s).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨e, he, I⟩, γ, hγ, s⟩ := I, D.crude_rows

steps.claim: Extend y to a basis of the rows: k vectors z_a from the good parts |𝖦|e₀·1(ψ) of crude forms ψ (these span the rows, by s), with y ⊕ z linearly independent (J) and dim rows(D) = n + k (c) (`exists_extend_basis_of_span_eq_top`).
steps.lean:
choose k z ψ J c using exists_extend_basis_of_span_eq_top i ((s ▸ span_image
    (D.goodProjTranslate 1)).trans (by simp [range_smul, NeZero.ne, Module.End.one_eq_id]; rfl))

steps.claim: Name the crude forms: z_a = |𝖦|e₀·1(ψ_a) (ez) with ψ_a crude (hψ).
steps.lean: choose ψ hψ ez using ψ

steps.claim: Apply `one_determinant` to u = Θ_D (on the rows), o = 1, the basis x = y ⊕ z, and the weights e; then compare the bound with V + 2δ + dim rows(D)·b_D.
steps.lean:
refine (one_determinant D.Θ (by simp) J (by simpa) (fun _ ↦ norm_map_det_gram_le fun σ ↦
    Sum.comp_elim .. ▸ covolumeSq_elim_le (ez · ▸ normSqAt_goodProjTranslate_le ((hψ _).2 σ))
    (hV σ)) (by simp) (hγ θ o) he (fun _ j ↦ (integralForms ⟨j⟩).carrier) k (fun ι j _ a _ b ↦ ?_)
    fun ι j ↦ (I _ ⟨j⟩ _ (o.1 ι)).imp' ((algebraMap ..).mapMatrix · |>.fromBlocks 0 0 ((γ (θ ι) /
    γ 1 : ℂ) • 1)) fun _ ↦ .imp (by grw [·]; simp [← RingHom.map_det, -RingHom.mapMatrix_apply])
    (by simpa [Matrix.one_apply] using! And.intro · fun a ↦ ez a ▸
    goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms ⟨j⟩ ((hψ a).1 _ _ ⟨j⟩ (o.1 ι)) 1)).mono (by
    rw [add_right_comm V, add_assoc]; simp [c, field] at *
    grw [(D.le_of_hasLogBound : _ + _ ≤ 4⁻¹ * D.b ^ 3)]; nlinarith [D.logB.exp_pos]) fun _ ↦ le_rfl

steps.claim: Size: every conjugate of the Gram determinant of Θ_D(1)∘(y ⊕ z) has modulus ≤ exp(V + k·(x_D⁹⁹ + x₁_D²b_D²)): the y-part has squared covolume ≤ e^V (hV), each z_a = |𝖦|e₀ψ_a has squared norm ≤ exp(x⁹⁹ + x₁²b²) at every σ (`Data.normSqAt_goodProjTranslate_le` with the crude bound), adjoining them multiplies the covolume by at most that (`covolumeSq_elim_le`), and `norm_map_det_gram_le` passes to the Gram determinant. Also Θ_D(1) is injective and y ⊕ z is a basis (J, c).
steps.lean:
refine (one_determinant D.Θ (by simp) J (by simpa) (fun _ ↦ norm_map_det_gram_le fun σ ↦
    Sum.comp_elim .. ▸ covolumeSq_elim_le (ez · ▸ normSqAt_goodProjTranslate_le ((hψ _).2 σ))
    (hV σ))

steps.claim: The scalars γ_ι = γ(θ_ι)/γ(1) are non-zero and |γ_ι|^(−2) has height ≤ 2m·m·2t·x⁹⁹⁹ (hγ, θ fit); the weights e have sums ≤ δ (he); the lattices are the ι-integral forms; the exponent is k; and the pairing of two integral forms is the hole proved in step 5.
steps.lean: (by simp) (hγ θ o) he (fun _ j ↦ (integralForms ⟨j⟩).carrier) k (fun ι j _ a _ b ↦ ?_)

steps.claim: The matrices: at a prime l, an embedding j and the twist θ_ι (l prime to its level, o), I gives an integral u with exp(−e(l)) ≤ |j(det u)| and Θ(θ_ι)(∑_k u_{ik}y_k) integral; extend it by the block diag(u, γ_ι·1_k), whose determinant has |j(·)| ≥ exp(−e(l))·|j(γ_ι)|^k, and whose second block gives γ_ι·Θ(θ_ι)(z_a) = γ_ι·ι_{θ_ι}(|𝖦|e₀ψ_a), integral by the crude integrality of ψ_a and `Data.goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms`.
steps.lean:
fun ι j ↦ (I _ ⟨j⟩ _ (o.1 ι)).imp' ((algebraMap ..).mapMatrix · |>.fromBlocks 0 0 ((γ (θ ι) /
    γ 1 : ℂ) • 1)) fun _ ↦ .imp (by grw [·]; simp [← RingHom.map_det, -RingHom.mapMatrix_apply])
    (by simpa [Matrix.one_apply] using! And.intro · fun a ↦ ez a ▸
    goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms ⟨j⟩ ((hψ a).1 _ _ ⟨j⟩ (o.1 ι)) 1))

steps.claim: `one_determinant` gives height ≤ V + k(x⁹⁹ + x₁²b²) + 2δ + k·4m²t·x⁹⁹⁹ for ι ↦ 𝔷_D(θ_ι)/𝔷_D(1); since k = dim rows − n ≤ (4/b²)·dim rows (c, hn) and x⁹⁹ + x₁²b² + 4m²tx⁹⁹⁹ ≤ b³/4 (size comparison), the excess is ≤ dim rows(D)·b_D.
steps.lean:
.mono (by
    rw [add_right_comm V, add_assoc]; simp [c, field] at *
    grw [(D.le_of_hasLogBound : _ + _ ≤ 4⁻¹ * D.b ^ 3)]; nlinarith [D.logB.exp_pos]) fun _ ↦ le_rfl

steps.claim: The hole of step 4.2: for x integral at j∘conj and y integral at j, |j⟨x, y⟩| ≤ 1 (`LevelPlaces.LevelForm.norm_inner_le_one` with A = 1: below the chosen level every stabiliser is trivial, `Data.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel` with #Y₀ ≤ n_m, `Data.card_Y_le`).
steps.lean:
simpa using (norm_inner_le_one _ _ ⟨j⟩
    (fun g ↦ by erw [D.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel (Subgroup.map_mono fun _ h ↦
    funext fun _ ↦ (h (.inl _) ⟨⟩).2) (by bound [D.card_Y_le .refl])]) a b :)
